fixedClock.how: Playwright clock: install + pauseAt before navigation; time only advances through clock.runFor(ms) steps recorded in each "reach" list

emulation.note: isMobile is false on purpose: with Chromium mobile emulation the <head> script on line 4 runs while the layout viewport is still the 980px fallback, so the page adds class "framed". hasTouch keeps (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) false. Every capture asserts html.framed is absent.

reachLegend.goto: load PrepAssist.html with that location.hash (handled by A.jump, L6971); no hash runs go("book")
reachLegend.call: expression evaluated in the page global scope (the prototype's own functions)
reachLegend.act: click() on the visible element whose data-act equals this value (prefix:true = starts with), in the top-most layer: sheet, reel viewer, top page, active stage
reachLegend.click: click() on the first visible element matching this CSS selector
reachLegend.fill: [selector, text]: set the input value and dispatch input + change
reachLegend.run: advance the fake clock by this many ms (fires the page's timers and rAF callbacks), then wait in real time for finite CSS animations/transitions to end. Every goto/call/act/click is followed by run 600 unless it carries its own run value
reachLegend.captured: an earlier state in the same scenario was captured here (its scroll captures ran and scrollTop was put back to 0)

registryCoverage.note: uiEntryPoints lists captured screens whose DOM contains a data-act that opens the key; an empty list means no captured screen links to it (it may still be opened from JS). For sheets, openedByActions are the A.* handlers whose live source calls SHEETS.<key>(). Based on the android dom.json files.

screens.title: One more step: final rest frame (all one-shot animations finished)
screens.timeDependent: Ambient loops keep running (stars, bokeh, haze, halo breath, rosette spin). "Day 239 · 126 days to Prelims" is static text.
screens.notes: The sequence is pure CSS started by adding .go to .st-wrap 60 ms after mount; the longest one-shot animation is the 11 s camera push (s4Push). The view-onestep-t#### captures are timeline frames. VIEWS.onestep is defined twice (L8496, L8542 with sound); the second is effective.
